PLD.name: Paladin
PLD.desc: Sword, shield, and an oath. Holds the line and the monster's hate.

SAM.name: Samurai
SAM.desc: A duelist's tank: posture and parry over shield and wall.

DRK.name: Dark Knight
DRK.desc: Greatsword and forbidden arts. Spends blood for power.

BLM.name: Black Mage
BLM.desc: Glass cannon with a death wish. Owns the burst window.

WHM.name: White Mage
WHM.desc: The traditional healer: great heals, protective spells, the final say over who lives.

MNK.name: Monk
MNK.desc: A battle-chanter: quick heals, mending-over-time, breath returned to the party.

aedri.name: Aedri
aedri.desc: Humankind. Balanced in all things, fearless in exactly the wrong ways.

valdren.name: Valdren
valdren.desc: The tall folk of Heartwood. Silver-eyed, long-lived, keen of mind.

karrog.name: Karrog
karrog.desc: The stone-patient. They outwaited the border; they will outwait the Return.

nym.name: Nym
nym.desc: Small deerfolk with delicate antlers and broad, rounded ears.

rasha.name: Rasha
rasha.desc: The foxfolk exiles. Sharp-sensed hunters; they heard the gates before anyone saw them.
